scenes.title: 4-BIT WEIGHTS
scenes.voiceover: Four-bit weights shrink storage. Does your answer change?

scenes.title: FULL PRECISION
scenes.voiceover: Full precision can store each weight in thirty-two bits.

scenes.title: SMALLER WEIGHTS
scenes.voiceover: Quantization uses fewer bits per weight. Four, in this example.

scenes.title: THE TRADEOFF
scenes.voiceover: Smaller doesn't mean identical. Less precision can change the result.

scenes.title: TEST YOUR TASK
scenes.voiceover: Compare memory saved and answer quality on your own task.

scenes.title: DEPENDENCIES INCLUDED
scenes.voiceover: Your script lists dependencies. Can uv install them?

scenes.title: PYTHON REQUIREMENT
scenes.voiceover: Your script can declare dependencies and require Python three point twelve.

scenes.title: ISOLATED ENVIRONMENT
scenes.secondaryText: Dependencies installed in a script environment
scenes.voiceover: Run it with uv. It prepares an environment from that metadata.

scenes.title: ONE DETAIL MATTERS
scenes.voiceover: Here's the catch: inline metadata means the project's dependencies are ignored.

scenes.title: MAKE IT REPEATABLE
scenes.voiceover: List what your script actually needs, so its environment travels with it.

scenes.title: INSTALL REFUSED
scenes.voiceover: Your install can fail before the build. Check the lockfile.

scenes.title: FROZEN INSTALL
scenes.voiceover: Npm ci makes zero lockfile updates. It expects the files to agree.

scenes.title: WHEN FILES DISAGREE
scenes.voiceover: If package settings and the lockfile disagree, ci stops. That's deliberate.

scenes.title: CLEAN START
scenes.voiceover: And it removes existing node modules before installing the locked dependencies.

scenes.title: CHECK BOTH FILES
scenes.text: Commit package changes with their lockfile
scenes.voiceover: Keep package changes and their lockfile together. Your CI install checks both.
